summary: I finished M8 and committed it locally on develop as a31d73e. Nothing is pushed. The reboiler is now met in the approved order: freed Selexol steam, then export steam, then syngas above 130 C, then reactor steam, with ZLD before the reactor when it is on. The heat recovery module also checks the pinch at the M6 reboiler temperature of 121.0 C. The utility balance, the IHX unit and the circulator unit run on the real helium flows, and T10 is filled. Gate rows now decide the flips, so the Headline preset flips T05 alone. T05 is the only flip-list term whose gate passed (the six T961-7 cooler duties). T04 waits on FS_GATE_M7 and T07 and T08 on the M6 column gate; all three failed, so those terms stay anchored. Every energy row in the plan's section 11 list is filled where a model exists. Build-order section 5 items 1, 2 and 4 are done, and the S11 variant is recorded as one sensitivity. I ran `nush2 drift`, read the section 7 limits and wrote the drift table into docs/FINAL_DESIGN_DECISIONS.md. Results were re-exported, and two exports match byte for byte. The Anchored goldens are unchanged. `cargo test --workspace` (dev profile) passes 310 tests with 0 failures, including the wasm tests. No section 7 limit is crossed, so there are no blocking findings. No OUTRAM PARK file or code was opened or used in this step. The name cleanup the user asked for later is not part of this step and was not touched.
done: engine/units/src/ihx.rs (new): counterflow rating by effectiveness and NTU, LMTD sizing, area at U 400 and 760 W/m2/K, HTTR module count (UA over 85 kW/K), cascade, the C.18 limits and the B.15 loss. Each function carries its eq: C.x or B.15 line, and the tests are named eq_c_*

engine/units/src/circulator.rs (new): B.9 helium flows from the duty, B.10 shaft work (same arithmetic as the anchored port), B.12 motor draw, B.6 temperature rise, B.14 duct loss on pipe diameter, and the C.16 Blasius drop, with eq tests

engine/plant/src/heatrec.rs (new): J.17 and J.18 allocation in the approved order, B.19 extraction branch, I.17 and J.30 grade and pinch check, F.11 syngas heat above the cut on a flowsheet stream, E.6 shift heat release. Adds the test reboiler_order_is_approved. The anchored balance now calls allocate and extraction

engine/plant/src/utility.rs (new): B.20 reactor_required, B.21 margin, J.29 import and J.24 e_total, all called by the anchored balance. level4() rebuilds the reactor side on the flows of a balance: helium flows, circulator power, IHX sizing, duct loss and the T10 secondary-loop drop at 199, 327 and 1079 reformer tubes

engine/plant/src/gates.rs (new): gate definitions per term, evaluation on (test_id, status) pairs, and the RECORDED table. engine/plant/src/terms.rs adds the preset rules (Headline flips T04, T05, T07 and T08 on a passed gate; Modelled takes every passed gate that has a flip path), fill_m4, fill_m6, fill_m8, the T03 slot, and preset_params and apply. A flip goes through the registry input the term replaces, or through a factor in ParamSet for T04, T07 and T08, so Inputs::params, the CLI and wasm all run the same preset

engine/plant/src/drift.rs (new): the term record, the Anchored, Headline and Modelled points at Case B REC_F, the seven section 7 checks and a markdown table. The CLI command `nush2 drift [--markdown]` prints them

vv harness: one GATE_ row per gated term, judged on the rows of the same export. The M6 gates must agree with nush2_units::bench::column_gate, or the harness stops. The CLI export runs the benchmarks first and refuses to write tables when the gates differ from gates::RECORDED

IHX benchmarks (engine/vv/src/ihx_bench.rs, new fixtures inl_11109.csv and iaea_tecdoc_1382.csv, both values checked against the PDF pages): INL-11109 Table 9 PDF p24 and TECDOC-1382 Table 3-23 PDF p168

Energy CSV: MIN_REACTOR_RATING, DUCT_LOSS, VESSEL_LOSS, CIRC_SHAFT_HEAT and POWER_BRANCH rows, so the reactor budget closes on its rows (test reactor_budget_closes_on_its_rows). REB_FROM_* rows show the approved order with source grades. WGS_RELEASE is filled from the matching flowsheet run. New runs B_REC_F_ANCHORED and B_REC_F_MODELLED, plus process-side rows for each FS_ run, including the 825 and 800 C runs

Build-order section 5 item 1: crosses_boundary is now derived from where each end sits on Figure 2, with the PSA and the battery limits outside and the stack and storage inside. RECYCLE_TO_REFORMER, H2_PRODUCT and TAIL_GAS_EXPORT now read false. Test crosses_boundary_follows_figure_2. Item 2: CRYO_H2_RETURN row added; CLOSURE_H and CLOSURE_MASS filled from the matching flowsheet envelope and left not_run where no flowsheet exists; WGS_RELEASE filled. Item 4: separate duct, vessel and shaft-heat rows
Decision S11: the FlowsheetSpec option h2_rest_to_recycle and the CRYO_H2_SPLIT sensitivity rows, with the default split unchanged

FDB: TERM_Txx anchored rows, TERM_Txx_MODELLED rows with the model note and gate outcome, and TERM_Txx_USED_HEADLINE and TERM_Txx_USED_MODELLED rows; L4_* rows for the Level 4 rebuild and the pinch. Three steam grades from TEV-961 A-57 PDF p81, read from the rendered page, added to parameters.toml: LP 307 F, HP 489 F, hot water 200 F

docs/FINAL_DESIGN_DECISIONS.md: new section 'Drift between headline and modelled terms' giving the anchored, modelled and used value and the gate for each term, the preset points, the section 7 checks and notes; section 8 updated for the new energy rows and the boundary rule. docs/VALIDATION_MATRIX.md: IHX and GATE rows and new totals
Results re-exported (7 CSVs); committed a31d73e with the 08 section 1.7 trailer
failed_or_skipped: Not built: reactor_table_10_1. Each of the 13 designs in htgr_ihx.md s10.1 needs a page I did not read, so no values were typed. Also not built: circulator_htgr_ihx_cases. Its four budget rows are the project's own screening budget, which the goldens already reproduce, so it would add no independent benchmark. tev961_table2_reconstruction already exists as T961-1 and T961-2, and T961-1-ROT825C stays failed

GATE_T10 is not_run: the library has no measured helium-side pressure drop for the finned reformer annulus or an IHX tube bank (card C.16, M14). The JAERI App. A-6 mock-up drop (35 kPa, measured with low accuracy) was not compared. T10 stays anchored at 200 kPa in both presets; 91.1 kPa is a lower bound
GATE_T03 is not_run: there is no complete replacing model, because upstream preheat needs Case 6 states that are absent. The Level 3 value, 109.65 MW, is printed only as a cross-check
T09 and T13 have no flip path into the anchored balance. T09's slot is the isothermal shaft-work limit, on another basis. Both gates failed anyway on FS_GATE_M7

The pinch is a grade check of each source against an isothermal reboiler. It is not a composite-curve problem-table analysis. No minimum approach is published locally, so only the sign is judged and the 9.0 K approach at the 130 C syngas cut is reported. No J.31 cooling-duty heat row was built; COOLING stays the electricity row
S14 (condensate CO2 vented as a sensitivity) was not done. It is an emissions-ledger row and belongs to M9. Build-order section 5 item 3 (one IEAGHG baseline value) was not in this step

The IHX U values of 400 and 760 W/m2/K are taken from plan section 9; I did not trace 760 to a primary page. The HTTR UA of 85 kW/K is the card C.14 figure read-off and was not re-read from the Tochio figures

math/eq_register.csv was not edited because it is outside my paths. Most function names were aligned to its engine_fn column, but four differ: J.17 is plant::heatrec::allocate (register says heatrec::stack), B.9 is circulator::secondary_flow_kg_s and primary_flow_kg_s (register says circulator::flows), C.16 is circulator::dp_blasius (register says ihx::dp_tube), and C.13 adds ihx::size. The S5 note on card H.6 is also still not added

Headline result rows keep the status anchored_port. The balance is still the anchored port, now fed with the modelled T05. This is disclosed in the export header and in the TERM_ rows. Anchored-run CLOSURE_H and CLOSURE_MASS come from the matching flowsheet envelope, as their source column says

Not run: cargo test --release, because of fat LTO. The release wasm build and its size were not measured; only `cargo check -p nush2_wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown` was run. fmt and clippy were run only on units, plant, vv and cli

Results changed for the site job: Headline now differs from Anchored through T05. The wasm tests pass against the new CSVs, but the site assets built from results/ will need a rebuild by that job. Its uncommitted frontend/panels.js, frontend/units.json and scripts/selftest.py were not touched

results_of_note: Case B REC_F reactor need: Anchored 179.040 MWth, Headline 178.494 MWth (spare 31.506), Modelled 178.475 MWth. Abatement 578,052, 578,052 and 577,933 t/y. Reboiler gap 13.823, 13.123 and 13.106 MW

T05 is flipped in Headline: modelled 8.387 MW against 7.686 MW anchored. Its gate T961-7 has all six Case 5 cooler duties within 10%; EX3 is the worst at 9.0%. Syngas above 130 C on the Level 3 stream at Case B is 7.904 MW

T01 is used in Modelled only: 0.7776 against 0.775. The Level 3 flowsheet split after the shift is 0.8256. The S11 variant moves it to 0.8231, with tube carbon down 11.4 kmol/h (1485.9 against the anchored 1574.1), so the carbon lines stay outside 2%

Slots that stay anchored: T04 1.650 MW against 0.877; T06 3.650 against 3.8 GJ/t (M6 gate failed); T07 0.909 against 0.869 MWe; T08 0.690 against 0.765 MWe; T09 3.373 MW shaft against 4.245 MWe; T13 23.099 against 23.232 MMSCFD (-0.44%, inside 5%); T03 109.65 against 120.80 MW. T10 is 91.1 kPa at 199 tubes, 38.8 kPa at 327 and 6.2 kPa at 1079, all lower bounds, against the 200 kPa budget
Pinch at the M6 reboiler, 121.0 C: LP steam 152.8 C (+31.8 K), export HP steam 253.9 C (+132.9 K), syngas cut 130 C (+9.0 K, the pinch), hot water 93.3 C (-27.7 K, excluded)

IHX on the Headline duty of 121.68 MW, balanced 25 K: UA 4.867 MW/K, NTU 17.36, effectiveness 0.9455, 12,168 m2 at 400 W/m2/K and 6,404 m2 at 760, 57.3 HTTR-size modules. Helium from the duty: 53.97 kg/s secondary (54.02 as the port scales it; the 0.1% gap is c_p 5195 against 5190) and 79.17 kg/s primary. Circulators 3.131 + 3.568 MW shaft, 7.443 MWe. B.14 duct loss 0.373 MW against the port's 0.307 MW (T12 stays anchored)
Shift heat release (HTS plus LTS): 8.07 MW at Case B REC_F, 11.34 MW at Case A INL_SEL, 7.14 MW at 825 C and 6.54 MW at 800 C

IHX benchmarks: INL-11109 Table 9, 8 of 8 outlets pass within 2 K, the worst 0.75 K (950 C, 7.1 MPa hot outlet 585.25 against 586). Duty within 0.24%. HTTR LP tests (TECDOC-1382 Table 3-23, UA from the same set): outlets pass within 5 K, the worst 2.31 K (30 MW primary 385.3 against 383). Measured heat imbalance 1.27% at 15 MW and 0.75% at 30 MW

Gates: T01 and T05 pass. T02, T06, T07 and T08 fail on SA-1, DICE-SRD, KW-SRD, MO-K16-TOUT, VI-3-SS2 and VI-3-SS3. T04, T09 and T13 fail on FS_GATE_M7. T03 and T10 not run. Validation rows 642: 324 pass, 29 fail, 249 reported, 40 not run
Case A REC_F economics moved slightly because T05 enters every run through Q_EX4_ABOVE_130C and Case A charges its reactor at the need. Case B charges 210 MWth, so its reactor capital is unchanged
